items.name: ContentFrame
items.description: Layout wrapper providing named slots for overlay, header, content, and footer with optional scroll behavior.

items.name: createEmitter
items.description: Creates a Vue-aware event emitter that automatically removes registered handlers when the host component unmounts.

items.name: CSSClassAtom
items.description: A single CSS class binding unit — string, conditional object, or null/undefined.

items.name: CSSClassValue
items.description: A full CSS class binding value — a single CSSClassAtom or an array of atoms.

items.name: Preloader
items.description: Loading overlay component with a spinner, supporting visibility control and configurable size variants.

items.name: SplitPane
items.description: Resizable split panel layout with a drag handle, collapse/expand support, and configurable horizontal/vertical orientation.

items.name: useElementOverflow
items.description: Reactively detects whether a DOM element overflows its bounds, tracking horizontal, vertical, or both directions.

items.name: usePointerDrag
items.description: Reactive composable for pointer-based drag interactions with axis control, threshold, inversion, and velocity tracking.

items.name: useProxyValue
items.description: Creates a buffered proxy ref that stages changes before committing back to a source ref, with optional auto-sync and debounce.

items.name: useStableLoading
items.description: Stabilizes a boolean loading state to prevent UI flicker by introducing a configurable delay and minimum visible duration.
